title: Credit Score Standards for SunPath Solar Lease Applicants and Assuming Buyers
content:
Two minimum credit scores apply under the SunPath Solar Lease: the score a lessee needs to sign the lease, and the score a home buyer needs to assume a lease when the home is sold.

| Tier | Minimum credit score to sign the lease | Minimum credit score of a home buyer assuming the lease |
|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | 650 | 650 |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | 650 | 650 |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | 650 | 650 |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | 660 | 650 |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | 680 | 650 |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | 680 | 650 |

The signing minimum rises with system size, from 650 for the three smallest systems to 660 for the SunPath 5.6 kW system and 680 for the SunPath 6.4 kW and SunPath 8.0 kW systems. The assuming buyer's minimum is 650 for every size.

### Illustrations on hypothetical scores

Each minimum is a floor the score must be at least equal to, so a score equal to the minimum meets it.

| Hypothetical score | Signs a SunPath 5.6 kW lease? | Signs a SunPath 8.0 kW lease? | Assumes a SunPath 8.0 kW lease? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 649 | No | No | No |
| 650 | No | No | Yes |
| 660 | Yes | No | Yes |
| 679 | Yes | No | Yes |
| 680 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
